remarks: OPEN HOUSE SATURDAY 10/10/2026 11:00 AM - 12:30 PM. So much potential, so much space, and a pole barn you won't want to miss! Situated on 2.6 acres in the Byron-Bergen School District, this spacious 4 bed, 2 full bath home offers over 2,200 square feet of living space and an incredible opportunity to make it your own. Inside, you'll find a roomy country kitchen, formal dining room, generously sized living room, convenient 1st floor laundry, and two staircases adding character and functionality to the layout. The home offers plenty of room to work with, along with a full basement, updated mechanicals, vinyl siding, a metal roof, an attached 2 story garage, and additional storage areas. The real standout is the impressive 30' x 60' pole barn! Complete with a car lift, 220V electrical outlet, upper level space, multiple storage areas, and a kitchenette area, this building offers exceptional versatility for automotive enthusiasts, hobbyists, or anyone looking for a substantial workshop. Outside, the 2.6 acre property provides plenty of room for outdoor activities, equipment, and additional storage. With a little vision and updating, this property has the potential to become something truly special. Bring your ideas and come see everything this unique property has to offer. Don't delay, schedule you showing today! Square feet in tax records is incorrect, actual sqft is greater than 2200 sqft, measured by listing agent.
